sentences.text:
M/S Veeram Securities Limited & Ors vs Unknown on 12
November, 2024
Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
12.11.2024 rc/ct.no.34 Item No.140 Crr No. 4784 of 2024

In the matter of : M/s Veeram Securities
Limited & Ors.
.......Petitioners Mr. Sandipan Ganguly Mr. Apalak Basu Mr. Debayan Ghosh Mr. Udayaditya
Banerjee Mr. Khaled Ali ...for the Petitioner

The petitioners seek quashing of proceedings being ACGR Case No. 5323 of 2024 pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Alipore, South 24-Parganas.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that about 151 deeds of conveyance were executed between the 1 st petitioner the opposite party company and out of total consideration amount of about Rs.25.00 crores in respect of the properties at Sonarpur about Rs.14.00 crores has been paid by the petitioners.

entities.text:
Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Alipore, South 24-Parganas
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Several disputes with regard to the title of the land, area of the plots and the like cropped up for which the parties entered into a Memorandum of Understanding on December 17,
2023 proposing to settle all the disputes and the opposite party company undertook to refund Rs.15.00 crores along with interest thereon upon payment of which the 1st petitioner would return the land to him.
Similar disputes arose between the parties with regard to the properties in Gujarat for which several civil suits were filed by the petitioners against the company.

The opposite party company lodged the present FIR against the petitioners under Section 406/420 of the Indian Penal Code alleging that the petitioners have failed to pay the consideration amount of Rs.2.00 crores and odd in connection with the 12 transactions which were made in 2021.
It appears on perusal of the material on record that the matter needs to be heard on merits.
The petitioners are directed to serve copy of the application along with annexure thereto upon the opposite parties and file affidavit of service on the adjourned date.
Let this matter appear under the heading "Contested Application" in the monthly list of February,2025.
It is submitted on behalf of the petitioners that investigation of the case is in progress.

No coercive steps be taken against the petitioners in connection with the present matter till February 28, 2025 or until further orders, whichever is earlier subject to the petitioners cooperating in the investigation.
All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
